sizing: If acted upon, 10-15% of intended final TSM sleeve as research position; this was NOT a verified historical instruction.
basis: By this date TSMC had published multi-year AI accelerator growth guidance, Q2 acceleration and large capex/CoWoS expansion, while Alphabet and Meta had independently signaled 2026 capex growth.
why_not_full_size: AI thesis was increasingly consensus, valuation had rerated from the April reset, and no recovered event-ready valuation/kill-criteria framework existed.
kill_criteria: persistent margin impairment beyond explained overseas/ramp effects

basis: Q3 operating evidence strengthened while trailing P/E had expanded to about 30.8x.
2025 earnings and margins were strong, but trailing P/E near 32x meant a larger portion of future success was priced in.

sizing: No automatic full-size entry. If no position and portfolio risk permits, a small research sleeve can be justified; larger sizing requires either a valuation reset with thesis intact or a fresh fundamental upgrade that raises expected value.
add_triggers: material price/multiple reset with AI/HPC demand, technology execution, margin framework and geopolitical operations intact
revenue/EPS guidance or upstream hyperscaler capex evidence rises enough to improve expected return despite price
trim_triggers: multiple expands materially faster than earnings estimates
expected return compresses without new evidence
exit_triggers: multi-quarter AI/HPC demand break and major customer capex cuts
high capex plus falling utilization/revenue guidance and deteriorating FCF
